about: Hospital financial assistance policies for the Tucson and Phoenix registry, by health system. Read from each system's own documents; checked by a second reader (research/assistance/second_reader_completed.xlsx: 114 of 131 values agreed, 87.0%; the 17 disagreements were resolved against the documents). 'Not published' means the source does not state it.

systems.policy: Banner Health Financial Assistance Policy for Hospital Patients, No. 770, version 6
systems.covers: Banner hospitals; uninsured and underinsured patients; physician, home care and imaging bills have a separate policy

tiers.insured: 100% discount off the balance after insurance
75% discount off the balance after insurance
50% discount off the balance after insurance

systems.above_max: Medically indigent household (medical expenses, Banner and non-Banner, above 50% of household income): 75% discount off the remaining balance or off the self-pay rate.
systems.assets_test: Only when there is no documented income: debt-to-equity ratio above 50% qualifies as medically indigent.
systems.window: Discount applies to covered services in the 12 months before and 180 days after qualification. Collection actions may start 120 days after the first statement.
systems.max_charge: Qualifying patients are not charged more than AGB. Uninsured self-pay rate is 125% of AGB.
systems.how_to_apply: Application online, in person at a hospital, or by mail; documents: prior-year tax return, 3 pay stubs and/or 3 bank statements.
systems.other_states_note: Same policy, Colorado hospitals: free care up to 250% FPL under Colorado HB 24-1399 (Arizona: below 200%).

systems.policy: HonorHealth Financial Assistance Policy (full policy); Income Guidelines; plain language summary
systems.covers: HonorHealth hospitals and HonorHealth Medical Group clinics; facility charges only (not ER physicians, pathologists, radiologists, anesthesiologists)

tiers.insured: Free care (application)
87% discount (application)

systems.above_max: Medically indigent household: pays 13% of the patient liability (after insurance for insured patients).
systems.assets_test: In extraordinary cases, assets that are disproportionately large compared with income may be treated as income.
systems.window: Apply within 240 days after the first post-discharge bill (can be longer); decision usually within 30 days of a complete application.
systems.max_charge: Not more than amounts generally billed for emergency or medically necessary care.
systems.how_to_apply: Uninsured: income attestation form. Insured: financial assistance application. May be asked to apply for Marketplace or public coverage first.
systems.notes: The full policy (2026-04-17) says discounted care is for income above 200% but less than 400%; the income guidelines say 201-400%. The full policy is used here.

systems.policy: CommonSpirit Health Financial Assistance Policy, Finance G-003
systems.covers: Uninsured and underinsured patients at Dignity Health Arizona facilities

tiers.insured: 100% discount off the balance

tiers.uninsured: Balance reduced to the amount generally billed (AGB)
tiers.insured: Balance reduced to AGB

systems.assets_test: Monetary assets of the family may be considered; retirement and deferred compensation plans are not counted.
systems.window: The later of 365 days after discharge or the date of care, or 240 days after the first post-discharge bill.
systems.max_charge: No patient eligible under the policy is charged more than the amount generally billed (AGB).
systems.how_to_apply: Application and plain language summary per hospital on the page.
systems.notes: Bands as written: at or below 200%, and at or above 201% but lower than 400%. Income between 200% and 201% falls between the two bands.

systems.policy: TMC Financial Assistance Policy (Community Care), version D; Sliding Fee Scale 2025
systems.covers: Facility and technical fees at TMC; not ER physicians, hospitalists, radiology, anesthesia or pathology

tiers.insured: 90% discount off the amount after insurance
80% discount off the amount after insurance
70% discount off the amount after insurance
60% discount off the amount after insurance
50% discount off the amount after insurance
40% discount off the amount after insurance
30% discount off the amount after insurance
20% discount off the amount after insurance

systems.below_min: At or below 100% FPL: not stated in the 2025 grid; ask the business office.
systems.above_max: Not eligible above 400% FPL; extenuating circumstances considered case by case.
systems.window: The web page says both that patients may apply at any time and that the application must be completed within 30 days of discharge.
systems.max_charge: Discounts applied to amounts generally billed.
systems.how_to_apply: Community Care application; business office 5151 E. Broadway #155, Tucson.
systems.notes: Grid dollar amounts use the 2025 poverty guidelines (revised 2025-03-20). Band mapping read from the grid header; the page example (family of four at 150% FPL gets 80% off the amount after insurance) matches it.

systems.policy: Mayo Clinic Financial Assistance Policy, Arizona, Florida and Wisconsin (MC5815-65)
systems.effective: not stated in the extracted text
systems.covers: Emergency and medically necessary hospital care at Mayo Clinic (policy also covers Florida and Wisconsin); not all services qualify

tiers.insured: 100% adjustment of the self-pay balance (only if Mayo Clinic is in network for your plan)
50% adjustment of the self-pay balance (only if Mayo Clinic is in network for your plan)

systems.above_max: Not eligible under the income criteria.
systems.assets_test: Yes: the thresholds apply to household income and assets.
systems.window: From the date of care until 240 days after the first post-discharge statement; may need to re-apply every 180 days.
systems.max_charge: An eligible patient's self-pay balance is limited to the amount generally billed (AGB); discounts are at least 50% of gross charges.
systems.how_to_apply: Application at mayoclinic.org/financialassistance or the patient portal.
systems.notes: Insured patients qualify only if Mayo Clinic is in network for their plan.

systems.public_district: Maricopa County Special Health Care District
systems.policy: Valleywise Health Financial Assistance & Uninsured Discount Schedule; Policy 99021 G (reviewed 05/26)
systems.effective: Policy 99021 G effective 2015-11, reviewed 2026-05; the 2026 schedule has no printed effective date
systems.covers: Valleywise Health services other than Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) clinics, which have a separate schedule

tiers.uninsured: Category 1: you pay 5% for outpatient services, $75 ER visit, 0% inpatient
tiers.insured: Category 1

tiers.uninsured: Category 2: you pay 30% for outpatient and inpatient services, $100 ER visit
tiers.insured: Category 2
Category 3
Category 4

systems.above_max: Uninsured patients above the categories: most services at 115% of Medicare rates; ER visit 115% of Medicare.
systems.assets_test: Resource assessment (means test) per policy 99021 G.
systems.notes: Schedule percentages are the share the patient pays (lower income, lower share). The schedule does not say whether the category rates apply to balances after insurance.

systems.policy: Abrazo Family Assistance Program; Compact with Uninsured discounts
systems.covers: Uninsured patients: Compact with Uninsured discount. Charity care for household income below 200% of the poverty level, subject to documented financial need. Scope for Carondelet not established.

tiers.uninsured: Charity care may apply (amount not published)
tiers.insured: Charity care may apply (insured eligibility not published)

systems.assets_test: Household finances and supporting documents are reviewed; no asset limit is published.
systems.notes: Values from the second reader's reading of the Abrazo page; the site returns HTTP 403 to automated clients, so the first reader could not confirm them.

systems.covers: Northwest Medical Center, Houghton, Sahuarita, Oro Valley Hospital; uninsured and underinsured patients
systems.above_max: Uninsured discount off billed charges for those who do not qualify for charity; catastrophic care discount when the account exceeds a share of annual income (share not published).
systems.assets_test: Financial criteria and supporting documentation; details not published.
systems.window: At the time of service or any time during the billing cycle.
systems.how_to_apply: FAP application from the hospital (the application file is disallowed by robots.txt for automated download; see MANUAL_DOWNLOADS.md).
systems.notes: Charity is 'based on multiples of the U.S. Federal Poverty Guidelines'; the multiples are not published on the page.
